notes.title: Update 1.21 Fixes to friend only lobbies
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that prevented players from joining a friend's game
 Developer names on the scoreboard will appear in blue

notes.title: Public Servers and King of the Hill!!!
notes.content:
Additions
Public Servers are now available!!!!!

Hamster can now hustle in the all new King of the Hill mode

New Customization Patterns

New Hats

Special thanks to our bug reporters for helping us out!

New Maps

Criss Cross - A map with four cages connected in the middle with a cross

Hardcore Parkour - A very small map with lots of jumps and verticality

Triple Trouble - A very small map with no jumping onto objects

New Match Ending, no more boring score screen


Changes
Main Menu Screen Completely Reworked

New Discord button! Join us to stay up to date and hang out with the community

Level Selector Screen Completely Reworked

Customizer Screen Completely Reworked

New Patterns option added

Emote Menu is easier to navigate and use

Emotes can now be triggered with keys 1–5 for quicker access

Lobbies now support up to 16 players

Lobby book updated to show the new King of the Hill rules

“Zoom-A-Lot” renamed to The Amazing Race

“Two Story” renamed to Double Trouble

  
Bug Fixes
Random tagging is gone

All emote sounds are now 3D and proximity-based

Crosshairs now enlarge and glow when hovering over a taggable player

VFX and pipe transparency no longer looks inverted/black


Extra Notes
Hey everyone, 
I just wanted to take a moment to update those of you who are curious about the future of Hamster Hustle and about us here at Dreamship Games.

Roadmap-wise, we’re planning to add more game modes. Infection is nearly finished, and Freeze Tag is in the works! We also have plans to include more emotes and maps in upcoming updates. It means the world to us seeing how much you’re enjoying our game and we’ve had an incredible time making it. Your feedback and creativity truly keep us going (yes, we’ve seen your Hamster Hustle fanfics and yes, we read all of them. They absolutely make our day, and we even set aside time during meetings for a little reading circle).

Now lets talk a little about us here at Dreamship. Unless you’ve joined our Discord (https://discord.gg/VJrnJ4TqRA, if you haven’t!), you probably don’t know much about us. We’re a small team of five passionate developers, and making games has always been our dream. Everything we build comes from a place of love for multiplayer experiences and the joy of making people laugh together.

That being said, we all work day jobs, so game development happens during our free time. With a small team working part-time, progress can take a bit longer... but we are incredibly grateful for your patience and support. We’re excited about what’s ahead and can’t wait to make even more fun, memorable games for you and your friends to enjoy. 

Thanks for being here with us and joining us on this journey. 
- The Dreamship Team

notes.title: The Hats Update is out now!!!
notes.content:
Additions

 Hats! Customize your hamster even more with the addition of hats!
 Use the credits screen to see who worked on the game!
 Upcoming updates, so you can see what we are working on for the menu!
 Added a front person camera so you can watch yourself doing emotes!

Changes

 Optimized models and lighting, performance should be a lot better
 Visual lighting and post-process adjustments
 Squeak sound effects adjusted so they are easier on the ears
 Emote Menu should be easier to navigate and use


Bug Fixes

 HUD items are not going away when returning to the lobby after a game
 Still being "IT" when returning to the lobby
 Getting stuck in the immune state and being untaggable
 The game ending screen shows up as soon as the game begins
